description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git am --abort' functionality within Git. It sets up various repository states and runs commands to verify that 'git am --abort' behaves correctly under different scenarios.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file for test setup.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the repository timestamp in tests.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the subsequent command fails.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_cmp_rev
methods.description: Compares revisions or states within the repository.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a specified path does not exist.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_dir
methods.description: Verifies that a specified path is a directory.

methods.name: test_tool chmtime
methods.description: Changes file modification time for testing.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after tests complete.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
